queued.title: Dupes lists a big card and its same-size edit as Exact copies
queued.what: detectDupes groups by byteSignature alone, which samples files over 320 KB, so two different same-size versions of a large card (an edited JSON card, say) are listed under Exact copies, whose hint says they're literally the same file. Thinning is safe: verifiedExactCopies leaves the different one alone. But the view says something untrue.
queued.reproduce: Make two JSON cards over 320 KB that differ only in a same-length edit about 300 KB in (see #96's test). Run processCardFile on each, then detectDupes([a, b]): one exact group, and wastedBytes counts the second file.
